slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Evaluate the trajectory
slides.subtitle: For agents, the path matters as much as the final answer.

slides.title: Output-only eval
slides.body: Does the answer look good? Useful, but incomplete for tool-using agents.

slides.title: Trajectory eval
slides.body: Which tools did the agent call, with what inputs, and did that path make sense?

slides.title: What can go wrong
slides.body: The answer may look fine while the agent skips data, calls the wrong tool, or loops.

slides.title: Eval record
slides.body: Store input, expected behavior, final answer, collected tool calls, and judge/check results.
